title: Residual: dominating-edge residual without level-wise half purity and outside the narrow two-card class
statement_en: Every graph in the dominating-edge residual (as in conj_kelly_ulam__connected_dominating_or_diam2__dominating_edge_impure) that has no level-wise half-pure vertex (as in level_half_pure) and is not in the narrow two-card class (as in two_card_narrow) is reconstructible. Open.
statement_lean: Recon.ClassReconstructible (fun n G => G.Connected ∧ Gᶜ.Connected ∧ (∃ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v ∧ ∀ x : Fin n, x = u ∨ x = v ∨ G.Adj x u ∨ G.Adj x v) ∧ ¬ (∃ u : Fin n, ∀ x y x' y' : Fin n, (G.neighborSet x).ncard = (G.neighborSet u).ncard → (G.neighborSet x').ncard = (G.neighborSet u).ncard → x ≠ y → x' ≠ y' → Nonempty (G.induce ({x, y}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({x', y'}ᶜ : Set (Fin n))) → (G.Adj x y ↔ G.Adj x' y')) ∧ ¬ (∃ u v : Fin n, u ≠ v ∧ (∀ T : Finset (Fin n), Nonempty (G.induce ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce (T : Set (Fin n))) → (T : Set (Fin n)) = {u, v}ᶜ) ∧ ∀ g : G.induce ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∃ h : G.induce ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), (∀ x : ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), G.Adj v (h x).1 ↔ G.Adj v x.1) ∧ (∀ x : ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), G.Adj u (g (h x)).1 ↔ G.Adj u x.1)) ∧ ¬ (∃ u : Fin n, ∀ j : ℕ, (∀ y : Fin n, G.Adj u y → (G.neighborSet y).ncard = j + 1 → ∀ x' y' : Fin n, (G.neighborSet x').ncard = (G.neighborSet u).ncard → x' ≠ y' → Nonempty (G.induce ({u, y}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({x', y'}ᶜ : Set (Fin n))) → G.Adj x' y') ∨ (∀ y : Fin n, y ≠ u → ¬ G.Adj u y → (G.neighborSet y).ncard = j → ∀ x' y' : Fin n, (G.neighborSet x').ncard = (G.neighborSet u).ncard → x' ≠ y' → Nonempty (G.induce ({u, y}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({x', y'}ᶜ : Set (Fin n))) → ¬ G.Adj x' y')) ∧ ¬ ((∃ d : ℕ, ∀ x : Fin n, (G.neighborSet x).ncard = d ∨ (G.neighborSet x).ncard = d + 1) ∧ (∀ x y : Fin n, (G.neighborSet x).ncard = (G.neighborSet y).ncard → Nonempty (G.induce ({x}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({y}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)))) ∧ ∃ u u' : Fin n, ∃ α : G.induce ({u}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u'}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∃ x : ({u}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), G.Adj u x.1 ∧ ¬ G.Adj u' (α x).1))
